mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_model_call_log (id, task_id, node_name, model, total_tokens, latency_ms, cost, error_code, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{nodeName}, #{model}, #{totalTokens}, #{latencyMs}, #{cost}, #{errorCode}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT l.*, t.user_id FROM ai_model_call_log l INNER JOIN ai_task t ON t.id = l.task_id WHERE l.task_id = #{taskId} AND t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY l.created_at ASC, l.id ASC

SELECT l.*, t.user_id FROM ai_model_call_log l INNER JOIN ai_task t ON t.id = l.task_id
ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT l.*, t.user_id FROM ai_model_call_log l INNER JOIN ai_task t ON t.id = l.task_id
ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_model_call_log l INNER JOIN ai_task t ON t.id = l.task_id

SELECT t.user_id AS userId, COUNT(l.id) AS callCount, COALESCE(SUM(l.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(l.latency_ms), 0) AS totalLatencyMs, COALESCE(SUM(l.cost), 0) AS totalCost, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.error_code IS NOT NULL AND l.error_code != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedCount FROM ai_model_call_log l INNER JOIN ai_task t ON t.id = l.task_id INNER JOIN lx_customer c ON c.id = t.user_id WHERE c.class_id = #{classId} AND c.state = '2' GROUP BY t.user_id
